remaining_limits: Native Apple CPU/Metal and Python3.13 only; no new Python3.14/Linux MLX/CUDA/Windows qualification.
Float32 training qualified. Float16 is a host-transport probe. Native bfloat16 host conversion explicitly unsupported.
Checkpoint remains weight-only; optimizer/RNG/scheduler/full or mid-window resume is outside selected scope.
Prebuilt caller lazy graphs retain original placement; a new stream scope cannot migrate already constructed work.
Hook reports and unlabeled deep-copied replacements remain positional; callers must preserve correspondence. Schema checks cannot detect arbitrary same-schema semantic swaps.
Seed replay promises the same environment; cross-device comparisons use tolerance and have no bitwise guarantee.
No new models, broad algorithm parity, mixed-framework conversion, MLX-LM/LoRA, accumulation or compiled execution features.
